region: us-central1 (same as bucket, no cross-region egress)
config_source: official config/stargraph/5_5/{gpt,nextlat}_stargraph_5_5.yaml, overriding only step count, out_dir, compile, and corpus paths
known_measurement_gaps: steady_seconds_per_step was parsed from the local log, not in-driver: the driver kept only a 60-line tail so its own estimate returned null (fixed in scripts/colab_profile.py for subsequent runs)
